blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating 360-degree panoramas requires both local perspective fidelity and global spherical continuity. Existing representations face a trade-off: equirectangular projection (ERP) enables seamless panorama modeling but suffers from severe distortion and a domain gap to pre-trained image generators, whereas cubemaps preserve perspective geometry but often produce inconsistent faces and visible seams. We present Squaring-the-Sphere, a panoramic image generation framework built on a novel representation CubeAtlas, which unfolds all cubemap faces into a single compact canvas. By arranging orientation-aligned, rotated polar regions alongside the equatorial faces, this representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps while organizing the cross-face relationships required for seamless panorama assembly. It further enables a pretrained diffusion transformer to model the complete panorama jointly in a single pass, without altering the backbone architecture or positional encoding. While CubeAtlas has a token count comparable to ERP, its structured layout makes many dense attention interactions unnecessary. We therefore introduce a layout-aware sparse attention mask that preserves the interactions required for panorama continuity while removing geometrically irrelevant token pairs. As a result, CubeAtlas achieves better quality than ERP modeling with lower attention computation. Furthermore, we introduce a training-free super-resolution technique and a fusion scheme that enhance fine details in distortion-free perspective space before achieving the final ERP panorama. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves geometric fidelity, cross-view consistency, and high-resolution visual quality over previous methods.
blocks.zh: 生成360度全景既需要局部视角的忠实,也需要全球球面的连续性. 现有表述面对一种权衡:等效投影(ERP)能够无缝的全景模型,但因严重失真和域间隙而导致预先训练的图像生成器,而立方体保存了几何视角,但往往产生不一致的面部和可见的缝隙。 我们介绍Squaring-the-Sphere,一个全景图像生成框架,它基于一个小代表Cube-atlas,它将所有立方体的面孔展开成一个单一的紧凑的画布. 通过在赤道面旁安排定向对接,旋转的极地区域,这种表示保留了立方体的几何视角,同时组织无缝全景组装所需的交叉关系. 它进一步使预先训练的散射变压器能够将完整的全景联合建模为单传,而不改变主干架构或位置编码. 虽然CubeAtlas具有相当于ERP的符号计数,但其结构化布局使得许多密集的注意力互动没有必要. 因此,我们采用了一种布局意识稀少的注意面具,它保留了全景连续性所需的相互作用,同时去除几何不相关的符号对. 因此,CubeAtlas比使用关注度较低的计算方式进行ERP模型制作,提高了质量. 此外,我们引入了无培训的超解析技术和聚变计划,在完成企业资源规划最终全景之前,在无扭曲的视角空间中改进精细细节。 对各种基准的实验表明,我们的方法比以前的方法提高了几何忠诚度,交叉视野的一致性,以及高分辨率的视觉质量。

blocks.en:
360 ∘ 360^{\circ} panoramas serve as a fundamental visual medium for a broad range of immersive applications, including virtual and augmented reality, gaming, telepresence, and 3D world modeling ( HunyuanWorld et al., 2025 ; HY-World Team et al., 2026 ; World Labs, 2025 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) .
Recent advances in image generative models have substantially improved the realism, diversity, and controllability of perspective image synthesis ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) .
However, how to transfer the powerful generative priors learned in perspective space to panorama generation remains an open challenge, as a panorama must simultaneously preserve local perspective fidelity and maintain globally coherent, seamless content over the entire sphere ( Figure 1 ).

最近图像分生模型的进步大大地改善了视角图像合成的现实主义、多样性和可控性(Esser等,2024;Black Forest Labs,2024;Wu等,2025;Cao等,2025)。
然而,如何将从视角空间学到的强大基因学前科转移至全景生成仍然是一个公开的挑战,因为全景必须同时保持局部视角的忠实性,并在整个领域保持全球一致、无缝的内容(图1)。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we identify the key challenge as selecting a panoramic representation compatible with pre-trained image priors.
The two most common choices are equirectangular projection (ERP) and cubemaps.
ERP represents the scene on a single equirectangular canvas, facilitating joint modeling of the entire panorama ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
However, its non-uniform spherical projection severely stretches polar regions, introduces geometric distortion, and departs from the perspective-image distribution learned by modern generators ( Liang et al., 2026 ) .
Cubemaps avoid ERP’s polar stretching by decomposing the sphere into six perspective faces ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Kalischek et al., 2025 ) . Although methods such as CubeDiff jointly model these faces through cross-face attention, preserving spatial continuity across face boundaries remains challenging.
Therefore, unifying ERP’s global coherence with cubemaps’ perspective fidelity remains a central problem for high-quality panorama generation.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们确定了关键的挑战,即选择一个与预先训练过的图像前作相容的全景代表.
最常见的两个选择是等分形投影(ERP)和立方体.
ERP在一平方形画布上代表了场景,促进了整个全景的联合建模(张等,2024;冯等,2023;吴等,2026;黄等,2026).
然而,它的非一相球形投影严重地拉长了极地区域,引入了几何扭曲,并偏离了现代发电机所学出的观点-图像分布(梁等,2026).
Cubemaps通过将球体分解成六个视角来避免ERP的极地拉伸(Tang等,2023;Kalischek等,2025)。 虽然CubeDiff等方法通过交叉式关注共同模拟了这些面相,但保持跨面相接的空间连续性仍然具有挑战性.
因此,将企业资源规划系统的全球一致性与立方体的忠实观点结合起来,仍然是高质量全景制作的核心问题。

blocks.en:
To address this trade-off, we propose Squaring-the-Sphere , a framework built on a new panorama representation termed CubeAtlas .
Rather than generating an ERP image or six independent cube faces, Squaring-the-Sphere unfolds the complete cubemaps into a single image-like grid and enables a diffusion transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) to model the entire panorama jointly in one forward pass, as illustrated by the CubeAtlas layout in the upper part of Figure 1 .
By combining half-polar rotation and packing for seam-aware yet compact face alignment with layout-aware sparse attention for efficient token interactions, Squaring-the-Sphere promotes cross-view continuity without the cost of dense global attention.
Crucially, our representation is compatible with existing DiT-based image generators without modifying their backbone architectures or positional encodings, thereby inheriting large-scale 2D image priors with minimal adaptation.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这种取舍问题,我们提议在CubeAtlas这个新的全景代表的基础上建立一个框架。
Squaring-the-Sphere没有生成一个ERP图像或六个独立的立方体面相,而是将完整的立方体展开成一个像图像一样的单一网格,并使一个扩散变压器(DiT)(Peebles和Xie,2023年)能够将整个全景联合成一个前行模型,图1上部的Cube-tlas布局就说明了这一点.
通过将半极旋转和接合意识但又紧凑的包装与布局意识的稀少的注意力结合起来,促进有效的象征性互动,Squaring-the-Sphere促进交叉视野的连续性,而无需付出全球密集关注的代价。
关键是,我们的表示方式与现有的基于DiT的图像生成器兼容,而无需修改其主干架构或位置编码,从而继承了规模庞大的2D图像前作而最小的适应.

blocks.en:
Concretely, CubeAtlas re-arranges the six cubemap faces into a compact three-band, four-column layout, as detailed in Figure 2 . For each equatorial orientation, it retains only the equator-adjacent half of the upper and lower faces, rotated to align with the corresponding equatorial view.
This half-polar layout retains the local context needed to connect each polar region to its neighboring equatorial faces while avoiding redundant polar tokens; complementary rotated copies are later combined to reconstruct the complete polar faces.
Polar rotation aligns polar content with the corresponding equatorial views, turning otherwise discontinuous cross-face relationships into locally organized neighborhoods within the grid, thereby facilitating seamless grid-to-ERP assembly.
We further introduce layout-aware sparse attention that preserves the intra-face and continuity-related interactions required for panorama generation while masking irrelevant token pairs.
Specifically, full attention is retained within each latitude band for horizontal consistency, while cross-latitude communication is mediated solely by the equatorial band: upper and lower regions never interact directly, and each equatorial region attends only to the polar regions on the same left–right or front–back axis.
Finally, we reproject the ERP into overlapping perspective cube views and apply a training-free 4 × 4\times super-resolution model ( Lu et al., 2026a ) to each view. Low-frequency correction preserves coherent color and illumination in the final ERP, while linear blending of overlaps solves discontinuities.

blocks.en:
We summarize three contributions of this paper as follows: • CubeAtlas representation is proposed that unfolds an entire cubemap into a single compact canvas with orientation-aligned half-polar regions. It retains only the equator-adjacent portions of rotated polar copies to reduce redundant polar tokens while preserving the context required for full polar reconstruction. The representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps, while resolving cross-face discontinuities, enabling seamless panorama generation and direct reuse of 2D image priors from pre-trained DiT generators. • Layout-aware sparse attention retains full attention within each latitude band while restricting cross-band interactions according to the spatial structure of CubeAtlas. This structured connectivity preserves the interactions needed for joint panorama modeling while avoiding unnecessary all-to-all attention among target tokens. • Comprehensive evaluation. We evaluate panorama generation from
complementary perspectives, including distributional fidelity, ERP and cubemap
boundary continuity, equatorial and polar perceptual quality, geometric
distortion, text adherence, and human preference. Extensive comparisons and
controlled ablations across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in
cross-face continuity and spherical geometric fidelity.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
360 ∘ Panorama Generation. Existing panorama generators are largely distinguished by how they represent the
sphere ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . ERP-based methods synthesize a single canvas, which facilitates global generation ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2023 ) , but polar stretching creates a mismatch with the perspective-image distribution of pretrained generators.
Panorama-specific adaptations address this mismatch through seam-aware processing ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) or hybrid perspective–panorama training ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Cubemap-based methods instead preserve perspective geometry while explicitly adapting the model to communicate across separate faces.
CubeDiff ( Kalischek et al., 2025 ) jointly denoises six faces through inflated attention and augments their latents with spherical UV coordinates, while DreamCube ( Huang et al., 2025 ) uses spherical coordinates and synchronizes attention to improve boundary consistency.
Although both support joint generation within a single forward pass, they retain separate face-wise spatial grids and introduce panorama-specific positional signals or operators to mitigate cross-face seams. Our method instead packs orientation-aligned cubemap faces into a single CubeAtlas canvas, turning cross-face adjacencies into local 2D neighborhoods and enabling seam-consistent panorama generation with the pretrained DiT’s native positional encoding and backbone structure.

layout is better matched to the target image prior.

Priors from Generative Image Models. Large-scale diffusion and flow-based image generators ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) provide strong priors for high-fidelity, controllable perspective-image synthesis. Directly

their standard spatial representations do not encode spherical periodicity or
polar convergence. Recent training-free adaptations, e.g., SpheRoPE ( Hirschorn et al., 2026 ) and SphereDiff ( Park et al., 2026 ) , modify

blocks.en: A panorama captures a complete 360 ∘ × 180 ∘ 360^{\circ}\times 180^{\circ} view of a scene from a fixed viewpoint, and the choice of how to lay this view out on a flat image plane has a decisive effect on generation quality.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Previous Representations
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 以前的代表

blocks.en:
Equirectangular Projection (ERP). ERP maps longitude and latitude onto the horizontal and vertical axes of a 2 : 1 2:1 rectangular image, providing a simple and compact representation of the full sphere.
However, its sampling becomes increasingly non-uniform toward the poles, causing severe horizontal stretching and departing from the perspective-image domain of pretrained diffusion models.
This mismatch makes it difficult to generate faithful geometry in polar regions. Moreover, spherical continuity is split across the left and right image boundaries, requiring explicit handling of horizontal wrap-around.
blocks.zh:
平方预测 (ERP). ERP将经度和纬度映射到一个平面和垂直轴上2: 1 2:1长方形图像,为整个领域提供了简单而紧凑的体现.
然而,它的取样越来越不统一,无法朝向极点,导致严重的横向伸展并偏离预先训练的传播模型的视角-图像领域。
这种不匹配使得极地地区难以产生忠实的几何. 此外,球形连续性被分出左右相像边界,需要明确处理横向环绕.

blocks.en:
Cubemap. A cubemap projects the sphere onto six perspective faces, each with a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} Field-of-View (FoV).
It avoids the severe polar stretching of ERP and better aligns with the perspective-image domain of pretrained diffusion models.
However, content that is continuous on the sphere is split across separate face boundaries.
Without effective cross-face modeling, generated faces can become inconsistent in appearance, semantics, and geometry, resulting in visible seams along cube edges.

它避免了ERP严重的极地伸展,更好地与预先训练的传播模型的视角-图像领域相配合.
然而,在球体上连续的内容被分出不同的面界.
没有有效的相面模型,所生成的面孔在外观,语义,和几何学上会变得不一致,从而在立方体边缘上产生可见的接合.

To unify both advantages, we propose a new representation that retains the perspective-face geometry of cubemaps while organizing their cross-face relationships into a single image-like canvas.

blocks.en:
We build Squaring-the-Sphere on a pre-trained image-editing DiT. The conditioning image is consumed directly:
we neither estimate nor provide camera intrinsics, camera pose, or an explicit projection of the input onto the sphere.
Instead, the model learns from data how to place the input content on the 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} CubeAtlas layout and synthesize its surrounding context.

我们用训练有素的图像编辑DiT 来建造星相 调节图像被直接消耗 :
我们既不估计也不提供相机的内在特征,相机的姿势,也不提供输入到球体的明确投影.
取而代之的是,模型从数据中学习如何将输入内容放入360QQ360Circ}CubeAtlas的布局并合成其周围上下文.

blocks.en:
The conditioning image follows the standard dual-path design.
It is jointly encoded with the text by the frozen multimodal encoder ( Bai et al., 2025 ) for semantic context, and independently encoded by the frozen VAE into clean visual condition tokens.
These condition tokens are concatenated with noisy CubeAtlas target tokens, and the DiT operates on the joint
text, target, and condition sequence.
We fully fine-tune the DiT using the standard linear flow-matching objective, which predicts ϵ − x 0 \epsilon-x_{0} from x σ = ( 1 − σ ) ​ x 0 + σ ​ ϵ x_{\sigma}=(1-\sigma)x_{0}+\sigma\epsilon , with σ \sigma sampled from a logit-normal distribution.
We make no changes to the DiT architecture or its rotary position embeddings.
Consequently, Squaring-the-Sphere preserves the strong perspective-image prior of the base model while adapting it to joint panorama generation in CubeAtlas space.

因此,Squaring-the-Sphere保留了基础模型之前的强烈视角-图像,同时将其适应Cube-atlas空间的联合全景生成.

blocks.en:
Although the CubeAtlas canvas has a token count comparable to that of ERP, dense attention over all its regions is not always necessary to maintain panoramic consistency.
A key advantage of CubeAtlas is that it makes geometrically adjacent faces locally connected while retaining a structured decomposition of the panorama.
We exploit this property with a layout-aware sparse attention mask over target-to-target interactions; text and condition tokens remain globally connected to every target token.
blocks.zh:
虽然Cube-Atlas画布具有与企业资源规划相当的象征意义,但其所有区域的密集关注并不总是保持全景一致性所必要的。
CubeAtlas的一个关键优势是,它使几何相邻的面相局部连接,同时保留了全景的结构分解.
我们利用这一财产,在目标与目标之间的相互作用上用一个布局意识稀少的注意面罩;文字和条件符号仍然与每个目标符号全球相连。

blocks.en:
Specifically, we partition the target into upper, equatorial, and lower bands.
We retain full attention within each band to preserve horizontal consistency, but block direct interactions between the upper and lower polar bands.
For cross-latitude communication, each equatorial face attends only to the polar half-regions aligned with its axis.
For example, L \mathrm{L} attends to { U L , U R , D L , D R } \{\mathrm{U}_{\mathrm{L}},\mathrm{U}_{\mathrm{R}},\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{L}},\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{R}}\} , whose complementary halves reconstruct its neighboring upper and lower faces.
Conversely, a polar query attends to all equatorial keys, allowing the equatorial band to serve as the
cross-latitude bridge.
Overall, the layout-aware mask retains 75 % 75\% of the target-to-target attention connectivity of dense attention, as illustrated in Figure 3 , while text and image-conditioning tokens remain globally connected to all target tokens.
Blocking direct attention between some regions does not prevent information exchange: features can still propagate through the equatorial band across successive DiT layers. The mask therefore structures cross-region communication rather than separating the panorama into independently modeled regions. Our experiments further show that this structured sparsity supports cross-view consistency while improving efficiency.

blocks.en:
To obtain high-resolution panoramas without heavy training, we apply a frozen 4 × 4\times Pixel Diffusion Decoder (PiD) ( Lu et al., 2026a ) in perspective space.
Specifically, the fused ERP is reprojected into six overlapping cubemap views with an enlarged FoV of 92.79 ∘ 92.79^{\circ} , which are independently enhanced by PiD and mapped back to the ERP domain.
This process upsamples the base panorama by 4 × 4\times along each spatial dimension, producing 10k ERP panoramas.
We linearly blend overlapping regions outside the FoV range of 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} to suppress cross-view discontinuities.
Since generative super-resolution may introduce low-frequency shifts, we further apply a correction strategy ( Yue et al., 2025 ) to anchor the global color and illumination to the base panorama while retaining the generated high-frequency details.
blocks.zh:
为了在没有重训练的情况下获得高分辨度全景,我们在透视空间使用被冷冻的4×4\times像素分解解解码器(PiD)(Lu等,2026a.
具体地说,已安装的ERP被重新预测为6个相重叠的立方体视图,放大的FOV为92.79 ∘ 92.79 ^{\circ},它们由PiD独立增强并被映射回ERP域.
这一过程沿着每个空间维度对基础全景进行4×4\的取样,产生出10克ERP全景.
我们线性地混合了90分线范围以外的重叠区域,以抑制交叉视断。
由于基因超分辨率可能引入低频相变,我们进一步采用校正策略(Yue等人,2025年)将全球颜色和发光放入基部全景,同时保留所生成的高频细节.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We initialize Squaring-the-Sphere from Wu et al. (2025) .
The VAE and Qwen2.5-VL condition encoder are kept frozen, while the denoising Transformer is fully fine-tuned for 8,000 8{,}000 steps with a global batch size of 64 64 and a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
We apply FlexAttention ( Guessous et al., 2024 ) for the sparse attention implementation.
Each cubemap face in CubeAtlas has a resolution of 640 × 640 640\times 640 , corresponding to a fused ERP panorama of 1280 × 2560 1280\times 2560 .
The super-resolution stage further upsamples the panorama by 4 × 4\times along each spatial dimension, producing a 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 panorama with a horizontal resolution of 10K.
Our evaluation benchmark consists of 100 100 self-collected images, together with 100 100 , 100 100 , and 118 118 panoramas from the RealSee3D ( Li et al., 2026 ) , Laval-Indoor ( Gardner et al., 2017 ) , and SUN360 ( Xiao et al., 2012 ) test sets, respectively.
We compare against CubeDiff ( Kalischek et al., 2025 ) , DreamCube ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , HunyuanPano ( HunyuanWorld et al., 2025 ) , and HY-Pano-2.0 ( HY-World Team et al., 2026 ) using their official inference configurations.
Unless otherwise specified, all comparisons are conducted on the base-resolution outputs without super-resolution refinement, ensuring a fair comparison across methods.
Additional datasets and evaluation details are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares Squaring-the-Sphere with representative panorama generation systems.
The metrics cover distributional fidelity (FID, KID, and CLIP-FID), ERP and cubemap boundary continuity (Seam ERP {}_{\text{ERP}} , Seam Cube {}_{\text{Cube}} ), equatorial and polar perceptual and geometric quality (Eq-* and Pole-*), and prompt adherence (TextAdh); full definitions are provided in Appendix D . Squaring-the-Sphere achieves the lowest Seam Cube {}_{\text{Cube}} on all four benchmarks, reducing the cube-edge error by 63 63 – 78 % 78\% relative to CubeDiff.
These results support the effectiveness of generating a single canvas directly to eliminate cross-face discontinuities.
Note that at Seam ERP {}_{\text{ERP}} values around 0.01 0.01 , further numerical differences may not translate into perceptible differences in boundary seams. We therefore interpret this metric together with the qualitative comparisons. Squaring-the-Sphere also leads Eq-GI and Pole-GI on every benchmark and ranks first or second in Pole-IQ, demonstrating improved equatorial and polar geometry.
Meanwhile, it achieves the best CLIP-FID on all three public benchmarks, leads FID and KID on RealSee3D and FID on Laval-Indoor, and obtains the highest TextAdh.
These results confirm that Squaring-the-Sphere improves spherical structure without sacrificing visual realism or textual consistency.

blocks.zh: 4.2 违约

blocks.en:
Panorama Representation. We first compare our CubeAtlas with ERP and cubemap generation, while keeping the backbone and other training settings fixed.
Both the ERP baseline and CubeAtlas use the same horizontal padding scheme, while all results are obtained without super-resolution or additional restoration for fair comparisons.
As shown in Table 2 , cubemap avoids ERP’s polar distortion but suffers from serious cube-boundary inconsistency.
CubeAtlas substantially reduces this error and achieves the strongest Eq-IQ and Pole-IQ, together with competitive distortion scores.
The visual comparison in Figure 6 further shows that CubeAtlas reduces both cross-face discontinuities in the cubemap and polar deformation in ERP.

Layout-Aware Sparse Attention. We compare dense and sparse attention under the same CubeAtlas representation.
As shown in Table 2 , sparse attention preserves comparable overall generation quality: it reduces Seam Cube {}_{\text{Cube}} and improves Eq-Aes, Eq-GI, and Pole-GI, while incurring only minor degradations in Eq-IQ and Pole-IQ and a modest increase in Seam ERP {}_{\text{ERP}} . Across representations, cubemap remains the most efficient due to its smaller token budget, whereas CubeAtlas is more efficient than ERP at the same token count. Importantly, CubeAtlas delivers consistently better generation quality than both representations, as shown quantitatively in Table 2 and qualitatively in Figure 6 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Squaring-the-Sphere , a representation-driven framework for text-guided
image-to-panorama generation. Its CubeAtlas representation jointly generates a
compact grid of equatorial faces and rotated half-polar regions, combining
cubemap perspective geometry with global continuity while retaining an ERP-like
token count. Layout-aware sparse attention further removes unnecessary
cross-region interactions, and geometry-free conditioning transfers pretrained
image priors without camera calibration or architectural modification. A
training-free perspective-space super-resolution stage produces the final
high-resolution ERP. Across diverse benchmarks, Squaring-the-Sphere improves seam
continuity and spherical geometry while preserving visual fidelity and text
adherence. These results highlight panorama representation as a simple and
effective route for adapting generative image models to omnidirectional synthesis.

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en:
Our current model is trained and evaluated at a fixed base resolution and does not explicitly support arbitrary-resolution generation.
In practice, however, the perspective-space super-resolution pipeline produces panoramas up to 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 resolution, which is sufficient for most downstream applications and makes output resolution unlikely to be a practical bottleneck.
As a generative model, Squaring-the-Sphere also depends on the quality of its textual conditioning.
We observe that accurate and detailed captions provide substantially stronger semantic guidance, particularly for regions that are not visible in the input perspective image, whereas vague or incomplete descriptions may lead to less coherent or less controllable generations.
More fundamentally, generating a complete 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} environment from a single perspective observation is inherently under-constrained.
Content outside the observed FoV must be synthesized rather than faithfully recovered, and multiple plausible panoramas may correspond to the same input image.
Finally, our current study focuses on static panoramas. Extending CubeAtlas to temporally consistent panoramic video and interactive scene generation remains an interesting direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们目前的模式是通过固定的基础分辨率进行训练和评价的,没有明确支持任意生成分辨率。
然而在实践中,透视-空间超分辨率管道产生的全景量可达5120×10240 5120\times 10240分辨率,这足以使大多数下游应用,使输出分辨率不可能成为实际的瓶颈.
作为一种基因模型,Squaring-the-Sphere也取决于其文字构造的质量.
我们注意到,准确而详细的标题提供了更强有力的语义指导,特别是对于输入视角图像中看不到的区域而言,而模糊或不完全的说明可能导致几代人不那么连贯或难以控制。
更根本的是,从单一角度观察生成一个完整的360QQ360Circ}环境本身就受到不足的限制.
观测到的FOV以外的内容必须被合成,而不是被忠实地取回,多种可能具有的全景可能与相同的输入图像对应.
最后,我们目前的研究侧重于静态全景。 将CubeAtlas扩展至时间上一致的全景视频和互动场景生成,仍然是未来工作的有趣方向.

blocks.en: Appendix B Supplementary Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 执行细节

blocks.en:
Our training corpus combines publicly available, internally collected, and synthetic panoramas. The public portion includes PolyHaven ( Poly Haven, n.d. ) , Humus ( Humus, n.d. ) , and PanoInfinigen ( Bozic et al., 2026 ) , together with additional street-view panoramas collected from Mapillary ( Mapillary, n.d. ) .
After quality filtering, these public sources provide approximately 50K panoramas.
We further include 20K internally collected panoramas covering street scenes and indoor environments, and render 5K synthetic data from Unreal Engine assets following the pipeline in Lu et al. (2025) .
Together, these sources form a training corpus of roughly 80K panoramas.
We sample real and synthetic panoramas during training at an approximate ratio of 6 : 4 6{:}4 .
blocks.zh:
我们的训练机构把公开的、内部收集的和合成的全景综合起来。 公共部分包括Polyhaven(Poly Haven, n.d.),Humus(Humus, n.d.)和Pano Infinigen(Bozic等, 2026年),以及从Mapillery(Mapillery, n.d.)收集的额外街道景观全景。
经过质量过滤后,这些公共来源提供约50K全景.
我们还包括20K内部收集的涵盖街道场景和室内环境的全景图,并在Lu等人(2025年)的输油管之后从不真实引擎资产中提供5K合成数据。
这些来源共同构成了大约80K全景的训练机构。
在训练期间,我们以大约6:4 6{}4的比例对真实和合成的全景进行取样。

blocks.en:
Our evaluation suite consists of three public panorama benchmarks and one self-collected image set. Specifically, we evaluate on 100 100 panoramas from RealSee3D ( Li et al., 2026 ) , 100 100 panoramas from the Laval-Indoor test set ( Gardner et al., 2017 ) , and 118 118 panoramas from the SUN360 test set ( Xiao et al., 2012 ) . For each panorama, we render a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} -FoV perspective view centered at the canonical viewing direction as the conditioning image.
Gemini-3.5-Flash generates the text prompt from the complete ground-truth panorama, providing a description of both the observed and unobserved regions. This setting therefore evaluates panorama generation under relatively complete scene-level textual guidance.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价套间包括三个公共全景基准和一个自我收集的图像集。 具体来说,我们从RealSee3D(Li等,2026年)评估100个全景,从Laval-Indoor测试集(Gardner等,2017年)评估100个全景,从SUN360测试集(Xiao等,2012年)评估118个全景。 每个全景,我们做一个90分 -FoV视角取景以克诺克视向为中心,作为取景图像.
双子座-3.5-Flash从完整的地面真实全景中生成出文字提示,提供了观测到和未观测到的地区的描述. 因此,这种设置在相对完整的场景层文字指导下评价全景生成.

blocks.en:
Our self-collected set provides a more challenging evaluation setting. It contains 100 100 perspective images spanning diverse visual styles, with 50 50 indoor and 50 50 outdoor scenes. Unlike the public benchmarks, no ground-truth panorama is available, and the text prompt is generated solely from the conditioning image. The model must therefore infer plausible content for the unobserved surroundings rather than relying on textual descriptions of the
complete scene. Since ground-truth ERP images are unavailable for this set, we report only reference-free metrics.
blocks.zh:
我们的自收自支集提供了更具挑战性的评价环境。 它包含100个100个透视图像,涵盖多种视觉风格,有50个室内场景和50个室外场景. 与公共基准不同的是,没有地面真实的全景,而文本提示完全来自调制图像. 因此,模型必须推断出未观测到的周围环境的可信内容,而不是依赖文字描述。
整个场景。 由于本集没有地面真实的企业资源规划图像,我们只报告无参考的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Importantly, none of the evaluation images are used during training. The same separation is maintained for all ablation models, ensuring that both the main model and all ablated variants are evaluated on entirely unseen data.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,培训期间没有使用任何评价图像。 对所有膨胀模型都维持同样的分离,以确保主要模型和所有膨胀变体都根据完全看不见的数据进行评估。

blocks.en: Training targets for Squaring-the-Sphere are constructed online in CubeAtlas space. Before VAE encoding, a 32 32 -pixel-wide strip copied from the left edge is appended to the right boundary as auxiliary horizontal context. This padding facilitates wrap-around seam handling but does not belong to the core CubeAtlas representation. During output assembly, the decoded padding context is used for boundary blending and then removed. The ERP ablation uses the same context-padding scheme for a fair comparison. Sparse attention is applied only to target-to-target interactions, while text and image-conditioning tokens remain globally connected.
blocks.zh: 在Cube-atlas空间在线建立了Squaring-the-Sphere的培训目标。 在VAE编码之前,从左边缘复制的32个32-像素宽条被作为辅助水平上下文附在了右边界上. 这种粘接能促进包接接处理,但不属于Cube-tlas核心代表。 在输出组装过程中,将解码的活页上下文用于边界相混合并取出. 企业资源规划的削减采用同样的上下文铺设办法进行公平比较。 分散的注意力只应用于目标与目标的互动,而文本和图像调节符号则仍然在全球范围内相通.

blocks.en: For each training panorama, we render a perspective conditioning view by uniformly sampling the FoV from [ 50 ∘ , 90 ∘ ] [50^{\circ},90^{\circ}] and the pitch angle from [ − 75 ∘ , 75 ∘ ] [-75^{\circ},75^{\circ}] , while fixing the yaw and roll angles to 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} . To improve robustness to diverse input formats, we render the conditioning image at a nominal resolution of 1024 pixels, with its aspect ratio sampled from { : 4 , : 1 , : 3 , : 9 , : 16 } \{3\!:\!4,1\!:\!1,4\!:\!3,16\!:\!9,9\!:\!16\} . For text conditioning, we use Gemini-3.5-Flash to describe the complete panorama rather than the sampled perspective view. For each panorama, we generate both a concise and a detailed caption and randomly use one of them during training, exposing the model to scene-level descriptions at different levels of granularity.

We train with AdamW using a global batch size of 64 64 , a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , betas ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (0.9,0.999) , weight decay 0.01 0.01 , and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 . The learning rate is linearly warmed up for 100 100 optimization steps and
then kept constant. We train our final model for 8,000 8{,}000 steps using exponential moving average (EMA). Training uses BF16 forward computation, FP32 master weights and gradient reduction, and activation checkpointing.
All experiments are based on 64 H20 NVIDIA GPUs.
blocks.zh:
我们与AdamW一起进行训练,使用全球批量的64 64, 学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5}, β (0.9, 0.999), 重量衰减0.01 0.01, 梯度剪接为1.0 1.0。 在100个优化步骤中, 学习率被线性热化
然后保持恒定不变。 使用指数移动平均值(EMA), 训练使用BF16前方计算,FP32主重和梯度减速,并启动检查.
所有实验都基于64个H20 NVIDIA GPU.

blocks.en:
We use frozen Flux-based PiD weights ( Lu et al., 2026a ) without panorama-specific fine-tuning.
To enable seamless fusion after super-resolution, the base ERP is reprojected into six overlapping
perspective cubemap views by slightly enlarging the FoV to 92.79 ∘ 92.79^{\circ} .
Each view has a
spatial resolution of 672 × 672 672\times 672 , where the additional context beyond the canonical 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} cubemap face forms the overlap regions with neighboring views. PiD independently upsamples each
view by 4 × 4\times to 2688 × 2688 2688\times 2688 , so the overlap regions are enhanced together with the valid
face content. The super-resolved views are then reprojected back to the ERP domain, where overlapping
regions are linearly blended to suppress cross-view discontinuities. After removing the corresponding 128px boundary context, each effective cube face has a resolution of 2560 × 2560 2560\times 2560 ,
yielding a final ERP panorama of 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 .

blocks.en: Appendix C User Study
blocks.zh: 附录C 用户研究

blocks.en:
We conduct a two-alternative forced-choice user study with 28 28 volunteers.
Participants are divided into four groups of seven, with each group comparing Squaring-the-Sphere against one competing method. Each participant evaluates all 100 100 scenes assigned to their group, resulting in 700 700 valid comparisons per competing method and 2,800 2{,}800 comparisons in total. Each trial requires a binary preference with no tie option.
For all methods, we use the base-resolution outputs without super-resolution. Compared methods are produced using their official implementations and inference settings. In each trial, participants are shown the conditioning image and text prompt together with two anonymized panorama results presented in randomized left–right order. Both panoramas can be freely explored using an interactive 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} viewer. Participants are asked to select the better result by jointly considering conditioning fidelity, visual quality, boundary continuity, and polar geometry.
As shown in Figure 8 , Squaring-the-Sphere is preferred over CubeDiff, DreamCube, HunyuanPano, and HY-Pano-2.0 in 96.7 % 96.7\% , 99.7 % 99.7\% , 85.7 % 85.7\% , and 63.0 % 63.0\% of comparisons, respectively.

blocks.en: We evaluate image-to-panorama generation along four complementary dimensions: distributional fidelity, boundary continuity, regional perceptual and geometric quality, and text adherence.

while CLIP-FID uses CLIP ViT-B/32 features; all metrics are computed with clean-fid Parmar et al. (2022) , with lower values indicating better performance.
KID is reported without additional scaling.

The regional prompts ask the judge to evaluate each view separately and then provide a score. For each view and criterion, they require a brief rationale followed by an integer score.

blocks.en:
Eq-IQ and Pole-IQ correspond to the “Image Quality” criterion, which asks for the overall quality of each equatorial view or polar close-up. Eq-Aes corresponds to “Aesthetic”, which asks how visually pleasing each equatorial view is. Eq-GI and Pole-GI correspond to the “Distortion” criterion in the respective regional prompts and are reported as geometric integrity for clarity, without changing the numerical scores. Higher scores indicate fewer distortion-related visual artifacts.
For Eq-GI, the prompt asks whether the view resembles a normal camera photo, with wavy or rippling lines, melted or broken objects, and shimmering moire or banding on regular textures lowering the score. For Pole-GI, the prompt asks whether the pole converges naturally and identifies swirl or vortex patterns, central black holes, radial cracks or seams, warped geometry, smearing, and nadir camera or tripod patches as defects. Thus, these criteria cover the specified geometric and structural artifacts as well as texture artifacts or polar patches, rather than a purely geometric reconstruction error. For each regional criterion, we first average scores over the corresponding views within each panorama, then over panoramas.

To validate the VLM-based evaluation, we sample 10 test cases and select outputs from three randomly chosen methods per case, yielding 30 panoramas that collectively cover CubeDiff, DreamCube, HunyuanPano, HY-Pano-2.0, and our method. Three independent raters, blinded to method identities and VLM scores, evaluate each panorama on Eq-IQ, Eq-Aes, Pole-IQ, Eq-GI, Pole-GI, and TextAdh using a five-point scale. blocks.en:
Figure 12 demonstrates the versatility of our geometry-free formulation across perspective inputs with varying FoV and viewing directions, including upward- and downward-looking images. Rather than relying on camera calibration or explicitly projecting the input onto a predefined panoramic coordinate system, Squaring-the-Sphere learns from data to infer the input view’s placement in the panorama and synthesize its surrounding content accordingly.
Red outlines mark the regions in the generated ERPs that correspond to the input views.
